# SwitchTender

> SwitchTender is a fleet automation control plane that runs from one binary. It runs Ansible,
> Terraform, OpenTofu, Bash, PowerShell, Python, and Go across a fleet from a single Go binary, paints
> every run as a live host-by-task matrix, splits big jobs by measured host cost, records a
> tamper-evident audit trail, and imports AWX projects, inventories, templates, surveys, and
> schedules in one command. State lives in one SQLite file by default, with Postgres optional.
> No Kubernetes, no Redis, no message bus. Source-available under BSL 1.1: everything shipped
> today is free to self-host and nothing ever moves from free to paid; paid tiers add new
> governance capabilities (SCIM, external approvers, evidence packs). Converts to Apache 2.0
> four years per release.

Install: `go install github.com/kordloom/switchtender@latest`, Homebrew, or signed release
binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows at https://github.com/kordloom/switchtender/releases.
Quickstart: run `switchtender serve`, open the browser UI. Try `switchtender demo` for a
seeded read-only tour.

## Start here
- Live demo, read-only and seeded with real runs, nothing to install: https://demo.switchtender.com

- [Homepage](https://switchtender.com/): what it is and the live matrix
